long_biography.plain_text:
Radovan Volmut trained in electrical engineering and became the first technical director of Zagreb's Vatroslav Lisinski Concert Hall shortly before it opened. He moved from congress organisation and major-project management into advising Eastern European investors on Croatian tourism and real estate, while also investing in Istrian tourism.

The next generation retained that interest in travel and property-based hospitality. Danilo Volmut worked in investment banking and consulting in Vienna and Zagreb, including privatisation and mergers work across southeastern Europe. He later built and led IstriaSelect through Exacto Nova, creating a booking platform focused on holiday homes and pool villas in Istria.
